summary: Verified announcement popup flags (student + landing) end-to-end. Backend pytest 6/6 passed against public preview URL: (a) PUT /api/site/content rejects 400 when >1 show_student_popup, (b) rejects 400 when >1 show_landing_popup, (c) accepts exactly one of each, (d) GET /student/site-announcements/pending returns {announcement: null} when no show_student_popup active, (e) returns matching announcement when active and /seen makes it disappear, (f) regular announcements (flag off) never trigger student popup. Frontend Playwright verified: SiteManager Pengumuman tab shows two checkboxes per news; enabling one row's student/landing checkbox auto-clears the same field on the other row (client-side mutual exclusion). Landing modal renders with title, ringkasan, Tutup + Baca Selengkapnya; after Tutup + reload popup does NOT reappear (localStorage-based). Baca Selengkapnya navigates to /berita/pengumuman-awardee-mdj-scholarship. Mobile 390px landing: horizontal overflow = 0px. Site content fully restored (all popup flags off) after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: get_pending_site_announcement inserts announcement notifications lazily on every GET (side-effect on read). Consider centralizing announcement->notification fan-out on PUT via notify_new_announcements so read endpoints are pure. Current design still meets spec but adds write-on-read cost.

The pending endpoint matches previously seen notifications by source_id OR (title,message). If a super admin re-toggles show_student_popup on an announcement whose text is unchanged, the student will not see it again because the earlier notification is still is_popup_seen=true. This matches 'sekali per pengumuman' spec, but is worth documenting for CMS editors.

In update_site_content, when payload includes announcements without news_categories, the announcement normalization pass still uses effective_categories fallback to reset unknown categories — behavior looks correct but the double normalization branch (rename-block + generic block) remains cognitively heavy (previously flagged in iter59).

Landing popup 'seen' state is stored only in browser localStorage; clearing browser storage or using another device shows the popup again. Acceptable per spec ('tidak muncul lagi pada browser yang sama') but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Original announcements preserved; both popup flags set back to False on both announcements via PUT /api/site/content after all tests. Verified via GET.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Popup feature verified. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_site_announcement_popups.py (run with pytest -o addopts="" to disable xdist parallelism; xdist causes race conditions since tests mutate shared site_content). Key test IDs: announcement-student-popup-{index}, announcement-landing-popup-{index}, save-site-content-btn, landing-announcement-popup, site-announcement-popup, dismiss-landing-announcement-popup, view-landing-announcement-button, dismiss-site-announcement-popup, site-announcement-popup-title, site-announcement-popup-message. Student popup won't re-appear in Playwright for a student user that already saw the same announcement in a prior run (is_popup_seen=true persisted in db.notifications) — that's per-spec 'sekali per pengumuman'. To force a fresh test, either use a different student account or delete the matching notification for that user & source_id.
